scope: Successor bounded repair in the existing P7 closure mission after the exact local full world/core regression exposed a timing-sensitive lock-lifecycle hole in the MW10 cross-region transaction repository. Port the already-proven atomic lock release and fail-closed staleness pattern from the canonical durable handoff repository (MW9 repair d1b49938) to the cross-region repository. No new protocol, authority, persistence format, channel, delivery mode or test-semantics change.

design_brief.problem_statement: The cross-region transaction repository lock lifecycle has two proven holes. (1) _remove_stale_lock treats a lock with missing/unreadable owner.json as removable: an empty owner dictionary falls through every guard (pid<=0, created<=0) and the live lock is deleted. (2) _release_lock removes owner.json in place before removing the lock directory, so a contender can atomically rename its candidate onto the momentarily-empty canonical lock; the releasing winner then observes a foreign owner and its release returns OWNERSHIP_MISMATCH even though its checkpoint commit already became durable. The combination yields the observed signature: a durable race winner whose worker reports failure plus a contender failure, i.e. zero self-reported winners with exactly one durable transaction.

failure_pair: Concurrent begin produced zero or multiple winners
Race durable winner differs from worker report
evidence.interpretation: Rarity proven by campaign, cause proven deterministically by the focused lifecycle probe on the unchanged baseline source.

design_brief.selected_design: Port the exact proven pattern from matter_durable_handoff_repository.gd (MW9 repair d1b49938, in-repo precedent): release by atomic namespace rename to a token-bound released path with bounded retries and no in-place owner removal; staleness decided fail-closed via _lock_is_stale (own-live fast path, ownerless grace fence from directory mtime, valid owner + liveness probe, unknown-liveness extended fence); stale reclaim by quarantine rename with token re-verification and restore-if-changed; _read_lock_owner_at helper; _lock_release_rename_override test hook reused by the focused probe exactly as tests/matter/handoff/test_mw9_lock_release_retry.gd does.
alternatives_rejected: Increase retry counts or timeouts: does not close the hole
Remove the failing assertions or relax the single-winner contract: hides the defect
Rewrite the race test workers or barrier: test and workers are unchanged owners of traffic
Replace the lock with a new cross-process primitive: new foundation, out of scope
Treat the single local failure as environment noise and rerun until green: forbidden rerun-to-pass
design_brief.affected_owner: MW10 cross-region transaction repository lock lifecycle only
non_goals: Change coordinator phases, authority gate, leases, checkpoints or persistence codec
Change MW9 durable handoff repository (already canonical hardened owner)
expected_risks: Shared repository affects all MW10 process scenarios and the P7 leaf
Fail-closed staleness must not deadlock crash recovery; covered by grace fence and dead-pid reclaim cases
Windows rename semantics; preserved by the same retry policy already proven by the MW9 repair
validation_plan: Focused deterministic lifecycle probe must FAIL on the unchanged baseline with exactly the predicted ownerless-grace-fence and atomic-release failures
The same probe must PASS on the candidate
Unchanged test_mw10_cross_region_processes repeated campaign must pass
Existing EG/MW siblings and the MW9 lock retry test must pass unchanged
Complete unchanged full world/core suite and all 29 P7 leaves on the exact final candidate
Frozen HEAD/TREE, digests, clean checkout evidence, fresh independent Reviewer and Verifier, PC0 non-RED before any human integration decision

required_outputs: Minimal owning repository patch with pinned blob guard
Before/after deterministic lifecycle probe with preserved baseline failure evidence
Exact-head full regression evidence and campaign digests
